VERSION 3.27.3.0

AFFECT [[3457600971405225497]]
    TRAVERSE QtObject
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT { property var quickShareController: null }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT [[2328484894988065446]]
    TRAVERSE ?#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                id: quickShareHost
                source: "file:///home/root/quickshare/ui/QuickShare.qml"
                onLoaded: {
                    Global.quickShareController = item;
                    item.defaultDialogHost = root;
                    item.screenAvailable = Qt.binding(function() {
                        return !root.passcodeHandler.userLocked && BatteryManager.displayState === BatteryManager.Normal;
                    });
                }
                Component.onDestruction: Global.quickShareController = null
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT [[12599552112012170435]]
    TRAVERSE ?#[[7713561876955258]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                id: quickShareSettingsPage
                anchors.fill: payloadLoader
                active: settings._selectedIndex === 7001
                visible: active
                source: "file:///home/root/quickshare/ui/QuickShareSettings.qml"
                onLoaded: item.controller = Qt.binding(function() { return Global.quickShareController; })
            }
            Item {
                id: quickShareDialogHost
                visible: false
                property var controller: Global.quickShareController
                property bool activeHost: settings.visible
                function updateHost() {
                    if (!controller) return;
                    if (activeHost) controller.settingsDialogHost = settings;
                    else if (controller.settingsDialogHost === settings) controller.settingsDialogHost = null;
                }
                onControllerChanged: updateHost()
                onActiveHostChanged: updateHost()
                Component.onCompleted: updateHost()
                Component.onDestruction: {
                    if (controller && controller.settingsDialogHost === settings) controller.settingsDialogHost = null;
                }
            }
            Component {
                id: quickShareNativeRows
                Item {
                    id: quickShareNativeRow
                    required property var model
                    property var nativeEntry: null
                    readonly property var quickShareEntry: quickShareAfterWifi.item
                    visible: model.visible
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    implicitWidth: nativeEntry ? nativeEntry.implicitWidth : 0
                    implicitHeight: quickShareRowContents.implicitHeight
                    Column {
                        id: quickShareRowContents
                        width: parent.width
                        Item {
                            id: quickShareNativeSlot
                            width: parent.width
                            height: quickShareNativeRow.nativeEntry ? quickShareNativeRow.nativeEntry.implicitHeight : 0
                        }
                        Loader {
                            id: quickShareAfterWifi
                            width: parent.width
                            active: quickShareNativeRow.model.index === SettingsPage.Wifi
                            sourceComponent: quickShareSidebarEntry
                        }
                    }
                    Component.onCompleted: {
                        nativeEntry = settings.delegate.createObject(quickShareNativeSlot, {model: model});
                        if (nativeEntry) nativeEntry.width = Qt.binding(function() { return quickShareNativeSlot.width; });
                        quickShareNavigationOrder.restart();
                    }
                }
            }
            Component {
                id: quickShareSidebarEntry
                ArkControls.SidebarItem {
                    id: quickShareSettingsEntry
                    type: ArkTokens.Sidebar.primary
                    text: settings.showLabels ? "Quick Share" : ""
                    iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/import"
                    highlighted: settings.highlightedIndex === 7001
                    showFocus: settings.current === quickShareSettingsEntry
                    onTriggered: activate()
                    function activate() {
                        settings.highlightedIndex = 7001;
                        settings.sideBarItemClicked(7001);
                    }
                }
            }
            Timer {
                id: quickShareNavigationOrder
                interval: 0
                onTriggered: {
                    var ordered = [back];
                    for (var i = 0; i < settingsRepeater.count; ++i) {
                        var row = settingsRepeater.itemAt(i);
                        if (!row || !row.visible) continue;
                        if (row.nativeEntry) ordered.push(row.nativeEntry);
                        if (row.quickShareEntry) ordered.push(row.quickShareEntry);
                    }
                    settings.navigationModel = ordered;
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE ?#[[4419331897656319922]]
        REPLACE delegate WITH { delegate: quickShareNativeRows }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
